correctness.rationale: The eight strict triangular interiors and twelve open edges and four vertices form a disjoint exhaustive partition of [0,2)^2. Vertices and the unique interior fixed point are separately checked. Each face area is exactly 1/2; normalized area yields 1/8 and 7/8. A standalone rational symbolic checker verifies every affine branch image and period identity and boundary inequalities. Grid checks are supporting diagnostics only.
